fact: On 7 July 2024 the LRA said it had registered at least 20,000 real properties (12,000 in Margibi, 9,000 in Grand Bassa) under a real property tax decentralization project that was still in its pilot stage in two counties.
title: LRA Real Estate Expansion Project Nets Over 20,000 Registered Properties In Bassa, Margibi
